cues: Two compounds, both with an O H group.
Ethanol, in every bottle of raksi.
And phenol, an O H on a benzene ring, the carbolic acid that Joseph Lister sprayed in his operating theatre in eighteen sixty seven, the birth of antiseptic surgery.
